name: Canadian Highlander
notes: Legality is inherited from Vintage: the format's own page states 'Canadian Highlander shares a banned list with Vintage', and every category it names separately (ante, sub-game, conspiracy, acorn, dexterity, silver-bordered, stickers/attractions) is already banned in Vintage. Spot-checked with Contract from Below, Shahrazad, Advantageous Proclamation, '_____ Goblin' and Chaos Orb.
Vintage's restricted list is moot here: the format is singleton, so every card is already limited to one copy.

Cross-check when updating: the March 2026 announcement moved Thassa's Oracle 6->5, Time Walk 6->5, Tamiyo 0->1, The One Ring 0->1, Minsc & Boo 1->0. All five agree with the values below, and the June 1 2026 announcement was 'no changes'. Points updates land roughly quarterly — re-verify against the source URL, don't trust a stale copy.
43 cards. Tiers in use: 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8. Ancestral Recall is the only 8.
